noPending: Nothing is waiting for manual approval.
approvalSettingsHint: The auto-approval model is set in the "Models & Services → Tool auto-approval model" route, which can include fallback models and the Jev decision model. When Jev denies or isn't confident, a text model in the route can review the call. Calls never run when the final answer is a denial, a timeout, or an invalid response.
pluginNotLoaded: The plugin isn't loaded. Saved permissions apply once the tool is registered again.
chatHint: Chat mode only offers basic conversation tools, such as the time, web search, and group chat history.
proactiveHint: Only new Proactive Loops use this default; running tasks keep the permissions they were created with. Manual approvals are sent to the owner and wait for an answer or a timeout.

preset.help: Switching presets fills in the risk matrix below and clears per-tool overrides.
preset.label: Permission preset

sandbox.help: When on, only this session's directory and temporary directories are writable. Requires Linux and bubblewrap.
sandbox.label: Shell workspace isolation

mode.feishuGroup: Feishu group chats always use Chat.
mode.label: Session mode

availability.hint: Pick a session to see which tools it can use and how they're approved.
availability.title: Tool availability
